title: [YSQL] Failed assertion in planner (PQ+BNL)
body:
Jira Link: [DB-17742](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-17742)
### Description

A tpc-h query crashes in planning:
```
co=# set yb_enable_base_scans_cost_model to true;
SET
co=# set yb_enable_parallel_append to true;
SET
co=# set yb_parallel_range_rows to 10000;
SET
co=# explain select
    nation,
    o_year,
    sum(amount) as sum_profit
from
    (
        select
            n_name as nation,
            extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,
            l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount
        from
            part,
            supplier,
            lineitem,
            partsupp,
            orders,
            nation
        where
            s_suppkey = l_suppkey
            and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
            and ps_partkey = l_partkey
            and p_partkey = l_partkey
            and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
            and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
            and p_name like '%seashell%'
    ) as profit
group by
    nation,
    o_year
order by
    nation,
    o_year desc;
server closed the connection unexpectedly
        This probably means the server terminated abnormally
        before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
```
Minimal query to repro, does not require `set yb_enable_parallel_append to true;`:
```
co=# explain select s_nationkey, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount
        from
            part,
            supplier,
            part_lineitem_1995,
            partsupp
        where
            s_suppkey = l_suppkey
            and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
            and ps_partkey = l_partkey
            and p_partkey = l_partkey
            and p_name like '%seashell%';
```
